assets.caption: EXHIBIT 4-38 — Setting Elevations of Centrifugal Compressors. Two hand-drawn elevation views: Arrangement "A" (Centrifugal Compressor, Horizontal Split Case Bottom Connections or Vertical Split Case Bottom Connections) showing compressor on an elevated pedestal with bottom suction/discharge nozzles routing downward, annotated with COMPRESSOR INLET LINE STRAIGHT RUN REQUIREMENTS (SEE EXHIBIT 4-46), CONSIDERATION FOR MISCELLANEOUS EQUIPMENT: INTERCOOLERS, LUBE OIL CONSOLE, ETC., and HEADROOM/MATCH LINE dimensions; Arrangement "B" (Centrifugal Compressor, Vertical Split Case Top Connections or Horizontal Split Case Top Connections) showing compressor on a low concrete pedestal at grade with top suction/discharge nozzles projecting upward.
